notes.cap: HEZE that can ever be issued across every deck; a unit of account inside the files, never a token
notes.awayHours: the most time a deck will catch up on when you come back
notes.secondsPerDay: how long a day is, in real seconds
notes.grant: HEZE a seat on the market comes with
notes.defaultDegree: the degree the board opens at
notes.dividend: share of the farm price paid per tranche on the farm's period
notes.volatilityBase: how far a farm's price swings
notes.volatilityPerDegree: how much wider each degree of syndication swings
notes.weightMin: the lightest a tranche can be weighted against its parent
notes.driftPeriodMul: a price's drift period, in multiples of the farm's period

text: The rulebook of the market. Keep a changed copy in the browser through the editor in the quarter and the market plays by it on its next load; write it into the yard and it plays by it for good.
